description: WHEN TO USE: To add one or more monitoring prompts to a project. Prompts are the questions asked to LLMs (e.g. "What are the best tools for X?"). Max 50 per request, 100 per project total. REQUIRES: project_id from lbm_list_projects. RETURNS: Array of created prompts with prompt_id. NEXT STEP: Call lbm_run_scan to run a scan with the new prompts.
name: lbm_add_prompts
